articles.title: SECI Awards Green Ammonia Contracts at Rs 49.75/kg in SIGHT Scheme Auction
articles.description: The Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited (SECI) has awarded fixed-rate procurement contracts for 7,24,000 metric tonnes per annum (MTPA) of green ammonia under Mode-2A (Tranche-I) of the Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition (SIGHT) Scheme.
